purpose: Corrected offline reassessment of the archived raw stdout of the public per-tool campaign. Same bytes, current evaluator; no invocation, no network, no manifest change. The published record is preserved unchanged.

manifest.frozen_by: independent reviewer (monchobotjr subagent; not an author of the harness or the tools under test)
manifest.frozen_by_correction: Recorded 'independent reviewer' before QA-04 changed the CLI default. The same engineer wrote the harness and froze the manifest. Independence from the tool implementation holds (neither tool under test was written by that engineer); an independent manifest review is NOT established. The frozen manifest is not edited; this is a prose correction only.

includes_fixes: QA-01 tool failure envelope -> unverified, not incomplete
QA-04 --frozen-by default no longer asserts independence
